def rms_forward(hidden_states, variance_epsilon=1e-6):
    """
    Calculates simple RMSNorm with no learnable weights. `MambaRMSNorm` will
    leverage this in order to multiply the final result with the RMSNorm weight

    Args:
        hidden_states (`torch.Tensor`):
            Hidden states to normalize
        variance_epsilon (`float`):
            The eps value to add in the square root scaling factor
    """
    input_dtype = hidden_states.dtype
    hidden_states = hidden_states.to(torch.float32)

    variance = hidden_states.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True)
    hidden_states = hidden_states * torch.rsqrt(variance + variance_epsilon)
    return hidden_states.to(input_dtype)

# FalconMamba

## Overview

The FalconMamba model was proposed by TII UAE (Technology Innovation Institute) in their release.

The model has been trained on approximtely 5800B tokens consisting a mixture of RefinedWeb with high quality technical data and code data from different sources. FalconMamba uses an RMS normalization on the internal states (B, C and dt) of the Mamba mixer block.

# Usage

Below we illustrate how to use the model:

```python
from transformers import FalconMambaForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
import torch

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("tiiuae/falcon-mamba-7b")
model = FalconMambaForCausalLM.from_pretrained("tiiuae/falcon-mamba-7b")

input_ids = tokenizer("Hey how are you doing?", return_tensors="pt")["input_ids"]

out = model.generate(input_ids, max_new_tokens=10)
print(tokenizer.batch_decode(out))
```

This model was contributed by [Younes Belkada](https://huggingface.co/ybelkada).

## Implementation

FalconMamba is Mamba with **RMS normalization applied to the B, C, and time-step (dt) states** inside the mixer — I based the implementation on the existing `mamba` model and added that difference plus a `mixer_rms_eps` config option.
